note: Read-only research. Nothing submitted or changed on GitHub. 'verified' = read in a primary source this pass; 'unverified' flagged inline.

recommended_stack.replay_checks: lake env leanchecker --fresh <Root>; #print axioms audit file

tools.tool: lake comparator / lake check (Comparator merged into Lean core)

config_shape.notes: enable_nanoda and external_kernels are mutually exclusive. Palomar accepts only the four required keys plus definition_names and enable_nanoda (ignored), rejects external_kernels, and limits permitted_axioms to propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice.

exit_codes.2: could not start (bwrap or manifest missing, bad config)

data_outputs: stdout 'Your solution is okay!' plus 'Uses axioms: ...'
traps: Sandbox needs Linux bwrap; on macOS only --inadvisably-no-sandbox (prints 'not trustworthy'), valid for trusted own code only
Project must have a committed lake-manifest.json
Full ConstantInfo equality for every constant reached from compared statements (value, hints, kind), not just types
Solution aliasing Challenge defs (abbrev X := Src.X) or re-declaring text under different imports fails; share a Mathlib-only Statement module imported by Solution
Challenge must be self-contained (Palomar: no project-specific source in its import closure) so Statement.lean must be kept byte-identical to Challenge minus theorems
set_option autoImplicit false in every Challenge or missing helpers auto-bind and change the theorem silently
Names in theorem_names/definition_names are holes: body not compared; definition holes need human review for vacuity
Both Challenge and Solution must import the default prelude
Do not compile the Solution before the Challenge
Green lake build and axiom audits say nothing about identity; always run a real replay
